parents.course: Advanced Topics in Food Science and Human Nutrition

ns2:section.sectionText: COVID-19 pandemic underlined the health disparities in the US and globally. Increased emphasis on "Diversity, Equity and Inclusion" highlighted the need for such a course that will provide the trainees with the scientific knowledge on the long-term consequences of structural racism. In this course, we will talk about the health disparities in the US and provide students with an introduction to the research tools that they can utilize in their research or future careers. We will also incorporate web-based tools like "Racial bias" tests and "Managing bias training" where students can assess their attitudes toward these issues. We will incorporate discussions and self-reflection opportunities to make the most of these exercises.
